quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #4
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: When rain or fog reduces visibility, drivers should use their:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in rain, snow, sleet, or fog. High beams reflect off the wet conditions and shine back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: After passing another vehicle, you should return to your original lane only when:

options.text: You can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: When passing is safe, wait until you can see both headlights of the other car in your rearview mirror. Only then is it safe to move back to your original lane.

questions.question: As blood alcohol concentration (BAC) increases, you become:
questions.explanation: BAC measures the amount of alcohol in your blood. The higher your BAC, the more impaired your driving ability becomes.

questions.question: When you see pedestrians near the road, you should:

options.text: Sound your horn and maintain your speed.
Speed up to clear the area quickly.
Slow down and pass with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and pass with caution.
questions.explanation: Watch for pedestrians who may cross your path. Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: When you approach a stopped school bus with flashing lights and an extended signal arm, you should:

options.text: Proceed at 15 mph if no children are visible.
Proceed at normal speed but watch for children.

questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop when a school bus has flashing lights and an extended signal arm. Remain stopped until the arm is pulled back and the bus moves. This rule applies regardless of the direction you are traveling.

questions.question: When entering a roundabout, you should slow down and:

options.text: Yield to cars already in the roundabout.

questions.explanation: When entering a roundabout, yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and vehicles already inside the roundabout.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road with traffic flowing in both directions.

questions.question: You must obey school crossing guards:
questions.explanation: Always obey school crossing guards when you see them near a school.

questions.question: If an accident causes over $500 in damage, you must report it:

options.text: No matter who was at fault.
Only if it was your fault.
Only if you are not insured.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter who was at fault.
questions.explanation: You must report any accident on a public road that causes $500 or more in damage. Report it regardless of who caused the accident.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the centerline means:
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line on your side means passing is not allowed. Solid yellow lines mark unsafe passing zones on two-lane roads.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. It tells drivers to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign indicates that the road ahead:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves right, then curves left.

questions.question: If you see animals near the roadway, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up to scare them away.
Slow down and proceed with caution.
Quickly swerve into the next lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: Slow down and proceed carefully if you see animals near the road. They may suddenly move or change direction. Animals often travel in groups, so more may be nearby.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When must you yield to a pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog?

options.text: Only when the guide dog is leading the person across the street.
Only if a crossing guard is present.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians using guide dogs or white canes must always be given the right-of-way.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: If you drive faster than other vehicles and pass many cars on a two-lane road, what will happen?

options.text: You will get to your destination much faster and safer.
You will increase your chances of a collision.
You will help prevent traffic congestion.

questions.correctAnswerText: You will increase your chances of a collision.
questions.explanation: Avoid passing on two-lane roads. Each time you pass another vehicle, your risk of a collision increases.

questions.question: If you must stop on an interstate in an emergency, what should you do?

options.text: Sound your horn at passing cars to get their attention.
Get out of your vehicle and flag down the first vehicle that passes.
Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle.
questions.explanation: If you must stop on the shoulder, turn on your emergency flashers and stay inside your vehicle. Standing or walking on an interstate is very dangerous due to high-speed traffic.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws that you must obey. This sign prohibits right turns at this location.

questions.question: How can you prevent yourself from becoming an aggressive driver?

options.text: Drive faster than the speed limit.
Drive very close behind other cars.

questions.explanation: Stay calm and focus on your driving. Do not take other drivers' actions personally. Allow extra time for your trip, follow speed limits, and be patient with other drivers on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill or downgrade is coming.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a steep hill or downgrade ahead. The hill may be very long or steep, and it may have sharp curves.

questions.question: On a slippery road, you should keep a following distance that is:

options.text: The same as on a dry road.
Longer than on a dry road.
Shorter than on a dry road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Longer than on a dry road.
questions.explanation: Your car needs more distance to stop on a slippery road than on a dry road. Always increase your following distance when driving on slippery surfaces.

questions.question: When a blind pedestrian with a guide dog or white cane is crossing the street, you must:

options.text: Tell them which way to cross.
Only give them the right-of-way at corners.

questions.explanation: Blind or partially blind pedestrians use a white cane or guide dog. You must always let them cross first, no matter where they are crossing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Get ready for traffic to merge, and be prepared to move to another lane.

questions.question: If you have a tire blowout, you should:

options.text: Tap or pump the brakes quickly.
Slow down slowly and use light braking.
Press the brakes hard and fast.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down slowly and use light braking.
questions.explanation: If a tire blows out, ease your foot off the accelerator to slow down gradually. Do not use the brakes until your vehicle has slowed significantly.

questions.question: When you see a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even without a stop sign.
Look for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: School zone signs warn you that you are near a school. Stay alert and be prepared to stop at any time.

questions.question: If you feel drowsy while driving, you should:
questions.explanation: If you feel tired, stop at the next rest area or safe place to take a nap, stretch, or let someone else drive. Caffeine pills and energy drinks are not a real solution and can make driving more dangerous.

questions.question: What can happen if you take prescription drugs while drinking alcohol?

options.text: You may not be safe to drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may not be safe to drive.
questions.explanation: Prescription and over-the-counter medicines can affect your driving ability. They are especially dangerous when mixed with alcohol.

questions.question: Even a small amount of alcohol in your blood can affect your:
questions.explanation: Any amount of alcohol can harm your ability to drive safely, even below the legal limit. Alcohol affects your judgment and coordination. Driving after drinking any amount can result in criminal charges.
